reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Connecticut
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Does the law require the tenant to respond to an eviction action before a hearing?
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -----------------------------

state(connecticut).
focus_year(2021).

eviction_action(eviction_action1).
defendant_in_action(eviction_action1, tenant1).
plaintiff_in_action(eviction_action1, landlord1).

% For "before a hearing", we encode that a hearing is scheduled after the return day.
return_day(eviction_action1, date(2021, 6, 1)).
hearing_day(eviction_action1, date(2021, 6, 10)).

scenario_statement :-
    state(connecticut),
    focus_year(2021),
    eviction_action(Action),
    defendant_in_action(Action, _Tenant),
    return_day(Action, ReturnDate),
    hearing_day(Action, HearingDate),
    date_to_serial(ReturnDate, ReturnSerial),
    date_to_serial(HearingDate, HearingSerial),
    HearingSerial > ReturnSerial.

% -----------------------------
% Date utilities (no external modules)
% -----------------------------

leap_year(Year) :-
    ( 0 is Year mod 400 ->
        true
    ; 0 is Year mod 100 ->
        false
    ; 0 is Year mod 4 ->
        true
    ;   false
    ).

days_before_year(Year, DaysBeforeYear) :-
    Y is Year - 1,
    DaysBeforeYear is 365 * Y + (Y // 4) - (Y // 100) + (Y // 400).

% Cumulative days before month in a non-leap year.
cum_days_before_month(1, 0).
cum_days_before_month(2, 31).
cum_days_before_month(3, 59).
cum_days_before_month(4, 90).
cum_days_before_month(5, 120).
cum_days_before_month(6, 151).
cum_days_before_month(7, 181).
cum_days_before_month(8, 212).
cum_days_before_month(9, 243).
cum_days_before_month(10, 273).
cum_days_before_month(11, 304).
cum_days_before_month(12, 334).

date_to_serial(date(Year, Month, Day), Serial) :-
    days_before_year(Year, DaysYear),
    cum_days_before_month(Month, DaysMonth),
    ( leap_year(Year), Month > 2 ->
        LeapAdj = 1
    ;   LeapAdj = 0
    ),
    Serial is DaysYear + DaysMonth + LeapAdj + Day.

add_days_to_serial(Date, DaysToAdd, NewSerial) :-
    date_to_serial(Date, Serial),
    NewSerial is Serial + DaysToAdd.

% -----------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
% -----------------------------

/*
  CT Gen Stat  47a-26 (2020):
  If defendant does not appear within two days after the return day, and plaintiff files
  a motion for judgment for failure to appear with an endorsed copy of notice to quit,
  the court shall enter judgment for possession (default).
*/
statute_ct_47a_26_requires_appearance_within_days(2).

statute_ct_47a_26_default_judgment_condition(Action) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    statute_ct_47a_26_requires_appearance_within_days(Days),
    return_day(Action, ReturnDate),
    add_days_to_serial(ReturnDate, Days, AppearanceDeadlineSerial),
    % Condition we would check in a concrete case: defendant failed to appear by deadline
    defendant_failed_to_appear_by_serial(Action, AppearanceDeadlineSerial),
    % and plaintiff filed the required motion and notice to quit copy
    motion_for_judgment_failure_to_appear_filed(Action),
    endorsed_notice_to_quit_filed_with_motion(Action).

/*
  CT Gen Stat  47a-26a (2020):
  If defendant appears but does not plead within two days after return day,
  plaintiff may file motion for judgment for failure to plead (served per rules).
  If defendant fails to plead within three days after receipt of such motion by clerk,
  the court shall enter judgment for possession (default).
*/
statute_ct_47a_26a_requires_pleading_within_days_after_return_day(2).
statute_ct_47a_26a_allows_default_if_no_plead_within_days_after_motion_received(3).

statute_ct_47a_26a_default_judgment_condition(Action) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    return_day(Action, ReturnDate),
    statute_ct_47a_26a_requires_pleading_within_days_after_return_day(ReturnDays),
    add_days_to_serial(ReturnDate, ReturnDays, PleadDeadlineSerial),
    defendant_appeared(Action),
    defendant_failed_to_plead_by_serial(Action, PleadDeadlineSerial),
    motion_for_judgment_failure_to_plead_filed_and_served(Action),
    motion_received_by_clerk_date(Action, ReceivedDate),
    statute_ct_47a_26a_allows_default_if_no_plead_within_days_after_motion_received(MotionDays),
    add_days_to_serial(ReceivedDate, MotionDays, PostMotionPleadDeadlineSerial),
    defendant_failed_to_plead_by_serial(Action, PostMotionPleadDeadlineSerial).

% -----------------------------
% Legal duties derived from statutes (what is "required")
% -----------------------------

% Duty to "respond" in the minimal sense: appear (CT  47a-26).
legal_duty_tenant(Action, tenant_must_appear_by_serial(DeadlineSerial)) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    return_day(Action, ReturnDate),
    statute_ct_47a_26_requires_appearance_within_days(Days),
    add_days_to_serial(ReturnDate, Days, DeadlineSerial).

% Additional duty if tenant appears: plead within two days after return day (CT  47a-26a).
legal_duty_tenant(Action, tenant_must_plead_by_serial(DeadlineSerial)) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    return_day(Action, ReturnDate),
    statute_ct_47a_26a_requires_pleading_within_days_after_return_day(Days),
    add_days_to_serial(ReturnDate, Days, DeadlineSerial).

% A "response required before hearing" if the statute imposes a deadline earlier than the hearing date.
legal_requires_tenant_response_before_hearing(Action) :-
    eviction_action(Action),
    hearing_day(Action, HearingDate),
    date_to_serial(HearingDate, HearingSerial),
    (
        legal_duty_tenant(Action, tenant_must_appear_by_serial(DeadlineSerial)),
        DeadlineSerial < HearingSerial
    ;
        legal_duty_tenant(Action, tenant_must_plead_by_serial(DeadlineSerial2)),
        DeadlineSerial2 < HearingSerial
    ).

% -----------------------------
% Placeholder factual predicates for default-judgment conditions
% (Not needed to answer this question, but included so statute predicates are complete.)
% -----------------------------

defendant_failed_to_appear_by_serial(_Action, _DeadlineSerial) :- fail.
motion_for_judgment_failure_to_appear_filed(_Action) :- fail.
endorsed_notice_to_quit_filed_with_motion(_Action) :- fail.

defendant_appeared(_Action) :- fail.
defendant_failed_to_plead_by_serial(_Action, _DeadlineSerial) :- fail.
motion_for_judgment_failure_to_plead_filed_and_served(_Action) :- fail.
motion_received_by_clerk_date(_Action, _ReceivedDate) :- fail.

% -----------------------------
% Answer predicate (deterministic)
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction_action(Action),
    legal_requires_tenant_response_before_hearing(Action),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require the tenant to respond to an eviction action before a hearing?
